note: Curated, human-reviewed observations. Derived flags are appended by tools/flags.py on every build. Counts and fixture lists that change on every refresh are derived (never hard-coded here) so this file cannot drift out of sync with the published inventory.

flags.item: Hotspawn lists a participant literally named 'DELETED' (#1082002, Arabian Regional Championship qualifier)
flags.detail: The Hotspawn fixtures API returns participants0_name = 'DELETED' for fixture #1082002 (2026-10-16 15:00 UTC, Arabian Regional Championship 2026: Lebanon-Libya-Syria-Palestine). Leaguepedia's page for the same qualifier records a series 'DELETED 0-1 S7raa' on the same date and time, so the placeholder is upstream in both sources. The name is reproduced verbatim; the original organisation is not inferred, and the card is marked stale with its recorded result.

flags.item: Komplettligaen removed Solid Gaming in Round 10; Hotspawn still lists its fixtures as scheduled
flags.detail: Leaguepedia's official Data:Komplettligaen/2026 Season/Autumn Split template records '|dqteams=Solid Gaming' and annotates the Round 10 fixture with 'Solid Gaming is removed from the league'. Every remaining Solid Gaming series in that schedule is entered as a forfeit - score 0-2 with the ff flag - in favour of the opponent (verified against the raw wikitext of the Data: page on 2026-10-23). Hotspawn still returns the four Solid Gaming fixtures (1071170, 1071200, 1071206, 1071186) with status='scheduled'. The pipeline therefore publishes a SETTLEMENT pick for those cards - the active opponent per the ruling - and no win probability. Earlier snapshots also carried fixture #1071216 (Solid Gaming vs DMG Esports Norway, 27 Oct 17:00 UTC); that card is no longer returned by the Hotspawn fixtures API as of the 2026-10-23 15:44Z check, so it is not published in this snapshot.
flags.delisted_note: Fixture #1071216 was returned by the Hotspawn fixtures API in the 2026-10-21 snapshot and is no longer returned as of the 2026-10-23 15:44Z check; it is kept in this note as the reason the earlier snapshot carried a fifth Solid Gaming card. It is deliberately not published as a row.
flags.verified_against: raw wikitext of Data:Komplettligaen/2026 Season/Autumn Split (action=raw) and the live Hotspawn fixtures API (competition_id=36279)

flags.item: Hotspawn crowd pick shares can diverge by 40+ percentage points from every real-money venue
flags.detail: Crowd shares are captured for audit only and never used as an input. The current worst case is recomputed on every build and published as its own derived flag above, with the fixture id, both teams, the crowd split and our line. Crowd percentages move whenever new users vote, so the figures are generated from the live dataset instead of being frozen into this file.
flags.verified_against: the live dataset: the derived crowd-vs-line flag is recomputed on every build

flags.item: Symmetric 1.80 / 1.80 aggregator placeholder odds are recorded and rejected (#1079080)
flags.detail: Odds aggregators render a symmetric 1.80 / 1.80 default on unpriced regional fixtures. data/flags_manual.json is not the enforcement point: tools/model.py rejects that exact pair (and any price implying more than 97% on one side) before de-vigging, and logs the rejection in data/matches.json under receipt_audit.rejected_quotes. Fixture #1079080 is priced from a live Polymarket full-series market instead of the placeholder.
flags.verified_against: archive/session-8336fb7e/data/book_receipts.json and the rejection path in tools/model.py

flags.item: 4 Nations Week 1 overturned forfeits for Team Reds recorded correctly
flags.detail: Team Reds originally won two Week 1 series in 4 Nations 2026 Halloween Heist, both subsequently overturned to 0-1 administrative forfeits for fielding an ineligible roster. The model consumes official post-ruling series records.

flags.item: Hotspawn displays the wrong name for the PvB slot in PRM 2nd Division
flags.detail: Hotspawn labels this team 'Phong Vũ Buffalo', but the five fixtures attributed to it (27 Oct 17:00 vs DKB XPERION NXT, 30 Oct 19:30 vs VfB eSports, 3 Nov 17:00 vs 404 Multigaming, 8 Nov 18:30 vs MT1 Esports, 13 Nov 18:30 vs regnum4games) are, in Leaguepedia, the five fixtures of 'PvB (Swiss Team)' in Prime League 2nd Division/2027 Season/Fall Split - same dates, same kick-off times, same opponents. The alias is therefore recorded explicitly in data/aliases.json with this evidence, not guessed. Hotspawn's card for these matches still shows the Vietnamese name and no logo.

flags.item: Hotspawn's tier and stage fields are null for most non-featured LoL fixtures
flags.detail: The fixtures API returns tier=null/stage=null (or, in earlier snapshots, tier='waiting for information') for most non-featured LoL fixtures, and best_of=null for every card in the current snapshot. Those values are reproduced verbatim and never inferred from the league name.
flags.verified_against: the live Hotspawn fixtures API response

flags.item: Leaguepedia is a community wiki, not a Riot Games property
flags.detail: Series results for the Elo model come from Leaguepedia's Cargo export (volunteer-maintained, the de-facto LoL esports results database). Riot's official LoL Esports API is used as a cross-check for the World Championship schedule only, because it does not publish these national leagues.
flags.verified_against: lol.fandom.com (the wiki itself is the source of the claim)

flags.item: Elo ratings are only comparable inside one opponent graph
flags.detail: Ratings are fitted per league network. A team that never played a common opponent with its fixture opponent cannot be compared meaningfully; those matches are marked provisional with the 'no shared-opponent chain' note.

flags.item: List horizon extends past the 7-day pick'em window
flags.detail: Hotspawn lists fixtures up to mid-November (the PRM 3rd Division round on 2026-11-15), beyond the current weekly reset. All listed fixtures are kept so coverage matches the site exactly.

flags.item: Hotspawn community pick percentages are stored but never used
flags.detail: The fixtures API exposes participants*_picked_percent. These values are persisted in data/raw/hotspawn_lol.json for transparency and are not read by the model, the picks, or any probability on the site.
flags.verified_against: the fixtures API fields and the model code path
